_doc: What each person fights with when they fight (docs/PLAYER_SYSTEMS.md §3). npcs: by world.json npc key; archetypes: by generic archetype id. weapon: a weapons.json id (absent = bare fists); armour: armour.json ids, at most one per slot. Chosen from each soul and WORLD_BIBLE; why says the reason. Minors carry nothing (the validator refuses any loadout for one). BaseNPC.get_combat_profile reads it through scripts/combat/loadouts.gd; a weapon set on the scene body wins over this

gregor.why: A shopkeeper's knife for twine and sacking; he has never fought and never will by choice

elena.why: Eighteen and five years fevered; she owns no weapon

mira.why: A tavern kitchen knife: the widow carries nothing a widow would not, whatever the Boss knows

bjorn.why: The smith fights with the hammer in his hand, in his leather apron

aldric.why: Twenty years a soldier of the Third Foot; he kept his steel and his mail, and drew it on the gate

mathias.why: Seventy-two, the council's head and the urn's keeper; he has never raised a hand

varn.why: A crown sergeant who walked out of Ashguard with a wagon of the King's arms

edric.why: The soldier-brother and quartermaster; a lord wears a sword at the palace, not mail

corwin.why: Sixty-three, failing lungs; the law is his weapon

seraphine.why: A noblewoman who has others carry what she needs

hollis.why: He never does violence himself and never says the word

ysolde.why: An infirmarian of the Dawn; she binds wounds, she does not make them

renna.why: Captain of the King's Rangers, in a rider's leather. She carries her father's bow too, but people fight at blade's reach here

wren.why: Thirty years the King's Ear; she keeps a knife and says she does not

oskar.why: The ferryman's pole, and the arms of a man who hauls a raft on a rope all day

dagna.why: A pick-handle and a miner's leathers; the foreman shouts first and swings second

lucan.why: Commander of Fort Ashguard, decorated twice; he carries himself like a man on parade

davin.why: Escaped from the Pit and hiding; his hammer is still at Bjorn's forge

garrison_soldier.why: Crown garrison issue: an iron sword, a jack and a helm

hollow_grunt.why: A body with a blade, in whatever leather the Hollow took off the road

peacekeeper_recruit.why: Aldric's farmers and cooper: a cudgel and a quilted jack; the cache under the well stays shut

courier.why: Riders on the Darkwood stretch carry a knife since the ditches
